traditional: 帶住犬儒嘅態度咁 + V
jyutping: daai3 zyu6 hyun2 jyu4 ge3 taai3 dou6 gam3 V

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something while distrusting people’s motives or ideals.

examples.english: They looked at the scandal cynically, saying that every politician was only out for themselves.
examples.traditional: 佢哋帶住犬儒嘅態度咁睇呢單醜聞，話個個政客都係為自己。
